text.p: DAY'S RANGE * SUPPORT * RESTNCE* MA-25 * MA-200
+ Schroders shares may reach 2000p following chart breakout from 1800p, technical analysts said.
+ But the shares will not be immune to any stock market weakness and this may cause near-term volatility.
+ Longer-term, a bullish chart pattern and a rising 200- day moving average should indicate the stock will whether any short-term storms.
Shares in independent investment bank Schroders stand a good chance of marching higher, technical analysts said.

Recent chart breakout from 1800p indicated upside for the stock although stock market weakness shortly afterwards sent it scurrying back. Further near-term volatility in the stock may occur but the longer-term trend should hold it in good stead, analysts said.
"The shares have broken above resistance at 1800p opening the way for further strength towards a target at 2000p," said Richard Marshall, director at Investment Research of Cambridge.
By 1055 GMT, the Schroders were up 40p to 1807-1/2p.

For the first few months of the year, Schroders share price bumped up to 1800p only to reel back. But each fall was less than the time before, indicating bargain hunters have been picking up the stock on dips.
This dithering of the share price has enabled its 200-day moving average to converge towards the shares confirming the stock's underlying strength.
And on a price chart, the shares have completed a technically well recognised bullish chart pattern.
"The chart pattern has developed an ascending triangle since February with good support coming from the rising 200-day moving average," said Marshall.
Maximum width of the pattern -- about 200p -- when added to the point of breakout gave the target of 2000p.
"The current breakout signals a new bullish leg (for Schroders)," said Marshall.
